review.notes: Re-reviewed the same sixteen fault categories for this controlled healthy-path native component timing scope. The authenticated Unix fork broker, pre-recovery policy rejection, original-thread signal-mask restoration and same-Core persistent native listener change the actual NativeBase and embedded artifacts. The process-lifetime Frida device owner avoids blocking SDK teardown on an unused failed-fork clone after the managed tree is drained. The model now binds their authoritative production sources and the separate actual source-fixture regressions. These sources are release context; the timed component workload does not claim to execute fork recovery, application signal handlers or product delivery. Functional before/after and full product gates remain separately required. Immutable build context: release-013-acceptance-r13; artifact SHA256 {"hyperhub": "535729536f8b00b993f58b04ef401458da9dcf9256f11da07933584e0037af94", "libhyperhub_engine.so": "8954ddcced32a22ab22e5c8c8adb9618152fe7dffa1446e0280405f2b26f6fb3", "libhyperhub_gum_agent.so": "a5ad8fcd54b90e6a0bca0b3a8193855c8c4a6bee7587f87d7b0157ff9376633c"}; Base context {"abi": 65536, "frida_version": "17.17.0", "hooks": 8191, "installer_protocol": 1, "native_base_sha256": "a23dc05b4ddf025d13f5d429fb0326dba4d5414f7b7991c74993f8cc1819bef2", "serve_base_sha256": "1ab0a09259195121185e553e7a0248775dbf2301fc6b5eaa500b4fe5f268651f", "state_schema": 2, "worker_protocol": 1}. Reviewed later test-only source deltas are explicitly recorded: the helper Host-registration oracle and the unified Linux Suite private0700 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR isolate actual CA artifacts from the full user runtime. Neither changes native timing workload or acceptance. The useful-work denominator, fixed baseline/upgrade trial order/count, overlap oracle, native timer boundaries, sampling, and 100ms soft-commit acceptance remain unchanged. The v11 source freeze was not measured. All actual v10 raw evidence and reports remain archived separately; observations are never pooled or selected.

categories.rationale: Native policy output and real post-commit sentinel semantics are checked against fixed explicit expectations.
The controlled workload matches the last of 32 ordered rules; release and retained generations are independently checked.
This performance model accepts bounded valid JSON and manifests only. Invalid-input capability regressions run separately and no hostile-input performance claim is made.
Current and pinned old generation identities must differ after commit, while old semantics remain callable.
Four active decision workers overlap actual native preparation and commit; no worker may fail or lose completed work.
Prepare and commit clocks are distinct from construction and RPC polling; the requested 100 ms soft commit budget is checked without a hard cancellation claim.
Each worker retains an old lease for the entire trial; real native old code remains callable across replacement.
Successful decision throughput and sampled unit latency are measured under the fixed four-thread/32-rule load.
Any native error, bad result or worker panic invalidates the run. Failure recovery is outside this healthy-path performance model.
The direct management component experiment performs no retries or fallback; control retry reliability is tested in the separate product Suite.
Preparation includes real immutable artifact installation and fsync, but no power-loss or process-interruption recovery claim is made by this timing experiment.
No coordinator RPC, participant fanout or subscription polling occurs inside the measured component boundary; those product boundaries require their separate tests.
Every measured decision calls the native C ABI through NativeEngine and verifies decoded result fields.
Both modes use the same valid 32-rule snapshot, four threads and retained baseline version; only actual upgrade differs.
Locally compiled trusted DSOs and deterministic fake paths contain no external credentials. Release authentication and hostile module security are separate acceptance gates.
Raw completed work, elapsed time, sampled unit latencies and distinct preparation/commit durations are preserved; no failed work is counted as success.
